d.ko: The Utawarerumono legend reaches a new climax in this sprawling JRPG! As a shadow falls over Yamato once more, Oshtor and friends set out on a fresh adventure—and somewhere, amid white mists, a long slumber approaches its end.
d.en: The Utawarerumono legend reaches a new climax in this sprawling JRPG! As a shadow falls over Yamato once more, Oshtor and friends set out on a fresh adventure—and somewhere, amid white mists, a long slumber approaches its end.
d.zh: 经典IP《传颂之物》系列最新作以RPG形式登场，走向新境界！不祥的阴影再度悄然逼近，开始笼罩大国「大和」。交织的命运，宣告奥修特尔一行人全新旅程的开始。
